summary: Independent fresh-context read-only reviews of the 2c stack (acting-profile ceiling on the calendar, live parties, invites, collections and party highlight reels) over several rounds, the last three on 3be5a39, 43fc82a and db81492, plus a confirmation of 6b0dd75. The reel is now cut from the title the ended row records (EndWatchPartyOn returns it via RETURNING; the generator runs after the end), so reel and gate cannot diverge; a failed end cuts no reel. The end splits title/episode checks, blanks text only on SQLSTATE 22, and falls back to a plain end. A row-scoped trigger harness refuses and counts updates; every party-end mutant tried was killed (reel from memory, hook position, unguarded retry, retry without the episode check, missing plain end, title/season/episode-row checks, failed-end fallback to memory). Last round: one low (stale test header comment), fixed in 6b0dd75, which is comment-only (token streams and comment-free ASTs identical). Residual gaps listed in the PR: a party whose every write fails stays active; the retry's episode check is pinned only as a whole; the change-media NUL strip is tested as a helper only. go build/vet clean; go test -count=1 ./..., tsc, vitest, npm run audit and TV unit tests pass.
